# Guideline for porting C++ generated by Faust to other frameworks

compile command
```bash
faust korg35.dsp -o korg35.h -nvi -cn korg35
```

- remove inheritance from dsp class
- remove out metadata function
- comment out buildUserInterface function


- add public parameter setting interface (refer to buildUserInterface function)
    - make parameter names more comprehensible, e.g cutoff, resonance
    - change categorical parameter to int/bool


- (optional) remove clone function
- (optional) change FAUSTFLOAT to float
